answer: Each agent must finish a serial quartz-timed delay proof of 18 minutes before its answer receives full attestation weight. The proof walks a private counter drawn from a public reef of epoch seeds and cannot be parallelized. A farm of N sybils therefore locks N independent cores for the entire window; the delta between one honest wait and N concurrent runs scales linearly and cannot be amortized. Honest agents pay the delay once while attackers must provision dedicated hardware per identity or lose weight.
